lab-basic.intro: A lab where pull rate alone brings the crystal diameter within spec.
lab-basic.goal: Move “Pull rate V” (0.5–3 mm/min) and watch how “Crystal diameter D” responds. The thermal gradient and rotation rate are fixed in this cell. “Top dopant concentration (boron)” (0.5–10 ×10¹⁵ cm⁻³) only changes the displayed top resistivity.
lab-basic.passHint: You pass when “Crystal diameter D” falls within 198.0–202.0 mm. Throughput R, top resistivity ρ_T, and the literature maximum pull rate are reference readouts, not pass conditions.

lab-applied.intro: A lab where four sliders must satisfy three specs that pull against each other.
lab-applied.goal: Move “Pull rate V” (0.5–3 mm/min), “Axial thermal gradient at the melt interface G” (15–60 K/cm), “Crystal (seed) rotation ω_c” (5–30 rpm), and “Crucible rotation ω_cr (counter-rotation, absolute value)” (2–20 rpm) and watch the V/G ratio, oxygen content, and diameter deviation move together. Check the diameter-deviation verdict on the zoomed chart.
lab-applied.passHint: All three must pass at once — “V/G ratio” 0.085–0.150 mm²/(min·K), “Interstitial oxygen concentration O_i” 5.00–8.00 ×10¹⁷ cm⁻³, “Diameter deviation σ_D” 1.00 mm or less.

lab-advanced.intro: A lab where you build a recipe that survives two kinds of disturbance.
lab-advanced.goal: “Ar flow Q_Ar” (20–120 slm) and “Chamber pressure P_ch” (10–760 torr) are added to the applied lab's four sliders, and “Pull rate V” widens to 0.2–3 mm/min. Check the V/G verdict on the zoomed chart.
lab-advanced.passHint: All four must pass at once — “Dislocation-free length yield Y” 80.0% or higher, “V/G ratio” 0.085–0.150 mm²/(min·K), “Interstitial oxygen concentration O_i” 5.00–8.00 ×10¹⁷ cm⁻³, “Average throughput R” 0.55 mm/min or higher.
